question_summary: Submitter asks whether the civil inspector can approve the excavation shoring setback at Placement Zone 2 near the property line, as the geotechnical report does not clearly address the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement, before backfill and compaction testing proceed.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: The question concerns a discrepancy between the geotechnical report and the excavation shoring setback specification, requiring the geotechnical engineer to clarify or confirm compliance before civil inspection sign-off.
